product_reasons.severity_explanation: Swelling batteries and constant overheating pose direct safety hazards to users. Frequent charging failures and rapid drain severely impact core functionality, leading to high return rates and potential liability.

Dead pixels, yellow tints, and poor scratch resistance directly impair the primary user interface. While not always a safety risk, it significantly degrades daily usability and increases warranty claim volume.
Frequent freezing, random reboots, and app crashes disrupt core workflows. These issues require urgent OTA patches to restore trust and prevent long-term churn.
Poor speaker/mic quality and unstable Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/signal reception compromise essential communication features. This directly impacts customer satisfaction and perceived product reliability.
Cheap buttons, inaccurate GPS, and malfunctioning proximity sensors indicate poor component sourcing or assembly. These durability concerns shorten device lifespan and increase support tickets.
Missing cables, tools, guides, and warranty cards are frustrating but easily resolved with replacements. Low business impact as they do not affect core device functionality or safety.
Broken seals, generic tape, and used items sold as new indicate fraud or severe QC failures. This destroys brand trust, triggers high refund costs, and poses potential hygiene/safety risks.

shipping_reasons.severity_explanation: Lack of padding, crushed boxes, and wet damage directly cause product defects upon arrival. This increases return logistics costs, damages brand reputation, and requires immediate packaging redesign.
Late deliveries and mislabeled express shipments frustrate customers but do not reflect product quality. Impact is manageable through better carrier SLAs and proactive communication.
Wrong items, mixed orders, and incorrect addresses cause significant logistical overhead, double shipping costs, and high customer churn. Requires immediate warehouse and routing process audits.
